bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
sha=9b1075b02564b5996904659ef48dadd178f87a13
base=create-videobot:invoice-only-9b1075b0
new=create-videobot:invoice-only-receipts-9b1075b0
stage=/home/gace/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/invoice-only-receipts-9b1075b0
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = b69612c64c22af1540b7294625658ebffa946270 || exit 41
git cat-file -e "$sha:src/sales/pgPostingReceipts.mjs" || exit 42
test -n "$(docker image inspect "$base" --format '{{.Id}}')" || exit 43
mkdir -p "$stage/src/sales"
git show "$sha:src/sales/pgPostingReceipts.mjs" > "$stage/src/sales/pgPostingReceipts.mjs" || exit 44
cat > "$stage/Dockerfile" <<'EOF'
FROM create-videobot:invoice-only-9b1075b0
COPY --chown=node:node src/sales/pgPostingReceipts.mjs /opt/videobot/src/sales/pgPostingReceipts.mjs
EOF
docker build --pull=false --network=none -t "$new" -f "$stage/Dockerfile" "$stage" >/dev/null || exit 45
src="$(sha256sum "$stage/src/sales/pgPostingReceipts.mjs" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
live="$(docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint sha256sum "$new" /opt/videobot/src/sales/pgPostingReceipts.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)"
test "$src" = "$live" || exit 46
out="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$out"' EXIT
if ! docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node "$new" --test test/paidListingPublisher.test.mjs test/pgPostingReceipts.test.mjs test/videoInvoiceSales.test.mjs >"$out" 2>&1;then
 grep -A 22 -B 2 '^not ok' "$out" | head -130 || true
 tail -n 12 "$out"
 exit 47
fi
tail -n 10 "$out"
echo INVOICE_ONLY_IMAGE_AND_POST_RECEIPT_TEST_PASS
